claims.text: Uses ``tiktoken`` (optional dep) for a real BPE count when installed; otherwise a ``chars/4`` heuristic.

claims.text: Degrades cleanly: the reduction *ratio* is meaningful either way, and becomes tokenizer-exact when tiktoken is present.
claims.why: Both branches return int; ratio meaningful; exact when tiktoken used.

claims.text: This is what makes the "92.8% smaller" claim rigorous rather than a hand-wave.
